gemini.value: La Mesa and Spring Valley merged into a single notice (DA-2026-36) effective August 14, 2026, with zero newly flagged shipments since the previous notice. This La Mesa quarantine covers a generated zone of about 120.5 sq mi (official: 173.0 sq mi) and includes 338.5 acres of commercial agriculture growing avocado, citrus, stone fruit, and tomatoes. Out of the current shipments, 8 need review, 5 are unclear pending a human check, 5 have no flag because they are not a host, and 7 have no flag because they are outside the zone. Operations verified 16 out of 17 citations.
